purpose: 원소 장식이 없는 회색 무속성 근접형·원거리형의 고정 몸통 부품 원화. 전투 상성 결정과 별도.

prompts.neutral-melee:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent modular 20-part enemy rig atlas for Element Eater.
Image 1 is the exact WATER enemy rig atlas to derive a new NEUTRAL / NO-ELEMENT enemy from. Preserve the same 4 columns and 5 part rows, the exact same round armored shell diameter and torso center, same part positions, same arm/foot sizes and all 20 separated parts.
Change ONLY color/material accents and remove the water crown: the entire enemy must be plain charcoal-gray and brushed silver-gray metal, with restrained warm ivory-white eye(s) and small ivory-white power seams. No blue, cyan, red, green, yellow, purple elemental coloring. REMOVE the entire water-fin/droplet crest; replace its socket with a small smooth flat gray cap integrated into the top of the round armor shell, with no projecting horns, ears, crystal, antenna, leaf, flame, water drop, wind curl, lightning shape or elemental emblem. Keep the top of the round body exactly where it was; do not enlarge or shift the body to fill space left by the removed crest. The empty space above the body should remain transparent.
Columns: FRONT facing down toward viewer, LEFT profile, RIGHT profile, REAR facing up away from viewer. Rear has NO eyes or front mouth and same gray brightness.
Row 1: ONLY detached closed round head-torso, no arms, legs or feet. Row 2 detached LEFT arm, row 3 detached RIGHT arm, row 4 detached LEFT boot, row 5 detached RIGHT boot. Never place an assembled full character in a limb row.
Actual transparent alpha background, clean fully isolated silhouettes, generous transparent gutters, no labels, numbers, text, grid lines, floor, cast shadow, checkerboard, scenery, projectiles or effects outside the parts. Match the original softly painted outlined cartoon mechanical golem style. This is one neutral base enemy, not an additional element.
Archetype identity: MELEE CHASER/BRAWLER, TWO narrow ivory-white hostile eyes, broad brow armor, squared gritted mouth, very chunky forearms and big gauntlet fists, sturdy boots. Preserve this heavy-fist anatomy.
